sloka: हतस्तु निपपाताशु धरण्यां रावणात्मजः।कवची सशिरस्त्राणो विध्वस्तः सशरासनः ।। ६.९१.७६ ।।
transliteration: hatastu nipapātāśu dharaṇyāṁ rāvaṇātmajaḥ।kavacī saśirastrāṇo vidhvastaḥ saśarāsanaḥ ।। 6.91.76 ।।

translations.english: Thereafter Indrajith with his shield, and helmet of the head broken was thrown on earth killed.
